value.rationale: The 2026 source gives an arbitrary-row construction but leaves a nonzero all-ell capacity gap; the exact reduction closes it for every parameter and derives a necessary optimal-section rigidity law. At ell=8 it makes the concrete code 25% larger than the source-selected shortened-Hamming construction and reduces redundancy from 4 to 3 bits. It bridges a new storage-channel optimization to a long-studied classical packing problem rather than merely tabulating a small case.
